Berkeley: TOEFL 90, UC application by 30 November

For English, Berkeley asks for TOEFL 90, or 4.5 on the new scale, or IELTS 6.5. UC applications for fall 2027 run from 1 October to 30 November 2026. The UC system has no early round: one application, multiple campuses. Scores by 31 January.

Source: admissions.berkeley.edu, admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

What's the semester contribution in Germany? Six universities

FU Berlin: €376.80 (winter 2026/27, transport ticket included)
Münster: €369.50 (winter 2026/27)
Bonn: €363.07 (winter 2026/27)
Bochum: about €350 (social contribution)
Freiburg: €190 (non-EU students also pay €1,500 tuition)
Stuttgart: €184 (non-EU students also pay €1,500 tuition)

Amounts are per semester, updated each semester, and exclude tuition. In Baden-Württemberg, non-EU students also pay €1,500.

Source: fu-berlin.de, uni-muenster.de, international.ruhr-uni-bochum.de, uni-bonn.de, student.uni-stuttgart.de, uni-freiburg.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“There is no tuition anywhere in Germany”

The truth: There are exceptions: Baden-Württemberg, TUM, FAU. Baden-Württemberg: €1,500 per semester for non-EU students. TUM master's: €4,000 or €6,000 (from 2027/28: €4,600 or €6,800). FAU will also charge from summer 2027.

Source: mwk.baden-wuerttemberg.de, tum.de, fau.eu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Applying on Studielink in four steps

1. Find the program: Pick the program on Studyfinder and check the application route on the institution's page. Some use a different route.
2. Register on Studielink: Open an account, add your past education and submit. The institution may then ask for more documents on its own portal.
3. Watch the dates: Numerus fixus closes on 15 January at 23:59; the general date is 1 May. Institutions may set earlier dates for non-EU applicants.
4. Accept the offer: Numerus fixus rankings come out on 15 April. If you don't accept the offer within two weeks, the place goes to someone else.

Apply to at most two numerus fixus programs a year; in fields like medicine, one application a year to that program.

Source: studyinnl.org (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Heidelberg: €1,500 per semester for Turkish students

In Baden-Württemberg, non-EU/EEA students pay €1,500 tuition per semester for a bachelor's and a master's in the same field. That is €3,000 a year. The semester contribution is paid separately. EU/EEA citizens do not pay this fee.

Source: uni-heidelberg.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
